title: Molecular Reactor: Corset Catalyst & Chess Reagent Balancer
description: A virtual chemistry reactor where the Corset model represents a catalytic molecular cage and the ABeautifulGame chess set pieces serve as draggable reagent tokens. The user must balance a multi-step chemical equation by placing the correct number of reagent chess pieces into the corset reactor, respecting conservation of mass, while using undo/redo to correct mistakes across 10-14 interaction steps.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements an interactive molecular reactor balancing task. Load Corset.glb and place it at center as a glowing catalytic reactor cage, slowly rotating. Load ABeautifulGame.glb, separate its chess pieces into individual meshes, and arrange them in a curved tray on the left side. Each chess piece type represents a chemical element: King=Carbon(C), Queen=Oxygen(O), Bishop=Nitrogen(N), Knight=Hydrogen(H), Rook=Sulfur(S), Pawn=Chlorine(Cl). Display a target equation at the top of the screen: 2CH4 + 3O2 + N2 → 2CO2 + 4H2O + 2NH3. The user must drag-and-drop the correct count of each element piece into the corset reactor (left side for reactants, right side for products). Use raycasting for click-drag interaction. When a piece enters the reactor, it shrinks and orbits inside the corset mesh like an electron cloud. Implement a conservation-of-mass counter displayed as a HUD: total atoms on each side must match. Show atom counts per element updating live. Add an undo button (Ctrl+Z) and redo button (Ctrl+Y) that revert or reapply the last placement, maintaining a full action history stack. After placing a piece, it glows green if it helps balance, red if it causes an excess. The task requires 12 total piece placements to fully balance both sides. Add a Verify button that checks if both sides are balanced; if correct, the corset reactor emits a particle burst celebration effect. Use OrbitControls for camera, PerspectiveCamera at position (0,2,5) looking at origin. Add ambient light intensity 0.6, a directional light from (5,10,7), and a blue point light inside the corset for reactor glow. Include a semi-transparent HTML overlay panel showing the equation, atom tallies, and undo/redo/verify buttons styled with a dark chemistry-lab theme.
